executive_summary.gate3_deferral_reason: Separate production materialization authorization from final manifest approval and locking.

scope: Process 18,845 accepted clips (from cohort3_audio) and 130 discrepancy-screened clips (from cohort3_rejected_quarantine).
Preserve all source files in their original locations without deletion, moving, or renaming (Rule P1).
Apply atomic no-clobber publication via os.link() on NTFS volume C:\ (Rule P2).
Execute three-decoder consensus verification (SoundFile, PyAV, miniaudio) on all staged files (Rule P5).
Generate per-file cryptographic disposition ledger (datasets/splits/stage6m_cohort3_materialization_disposition_ledger.csv) (Rule P6).
Independently audit all 18,975 destination file identities, sizes, and SHA-256 digests.
STRICT BOUNDARY: Gate 3A must NOT generate or lock the final manifest.
STOP IMMEDIATELY after audio materialization, decoder validation, and ledger emission.

gate3b_specification.checkpoint: GATE 3B — FINAL MANIFEST VALIDATION AND LOCK
preconditions: Destination directory cohort3_reconciled_assets/ contains exactly 18,975 validated audio files totaling 709,750,958 bytes.
Per-file disposition ledger independently reconciled against target population (1,252 complete speakers, 9 partial speakers, 4 empty speakers = 1,265 total speakers).

Confirmatory evaluation cohort satisfies exact five-stratum parity (Australian, Canadian, England, South Asian, US English; exactly 220 speakers and 3,300 clips per stratum = 1,100 speakers / 16,500 clips).
Gate cohort (100 speakers / 1,500 clips; 20 per stratum) and reserve cohort (65 speakers / 975 clips) strict isolation verified.
action: Record cryptographic SHA-256 seal of the final manifest.
Authorize progression to Gate 4 (GPU Environment Readiness).

boundary_guard_enforcement.evidence: When invoked against production destination without --authorize-gate3a, script logs error 'BLOCKED_UNAUTHORIZED: Gate 2 authorizes implementation and pre-production validation ONLY. Production dataset materialization into cohort3_reconciled_assets/ requires explicit Gate 3A authorization...', prints to stderr, and halts execution via sys.exit(2). Verified by test_production_boundary_guard_blocks_unauthorized_materialization.

audit_criteria.evidence: Source files opened strictly in binary read mode ('rb'). Source path identity check prevents source == dest. No unlink, rename, or write handles opened on source.
Publication executed via os.link(). Under Windows NTFS, os.link() raises FileExistsError on destination collision. os.replace() is strictly prohibited.
Pre-check compares destination SHA-256 against expected hash. Existing matching files skip extraction (0 disk writes). Mismatched files fail closed with DestinationCollisionMismatchError.
RunLockManager acquires exclusive non-blocking lock via msvcrt.locking(LK_NBLCK, 1) on Windows (fcntl.flock on POSIX). Sweep routine strictly ignores directories with active locks.
verify_audio_three_decoders runs SoundFile streaming decode (4096-frame chunks, verifying finite float32 PCM), PyAV, and miniaudio. Consensus required before publication.
All 18,975 assets (18,845 accepted + 130 discrepancy-screened) tracked in stage6m_cohort3_materialization_disposition_ledger.csv with action, hash, size, frames, and decodability status.
Staging occurs in unique .staging_run_{run_id} directories. Unlinked on clean completion. sweep_orphaned_staging_directories safely cleans stale runs (>3600s) only if lock acquisition succeeds.

Script enforces BLOCKED_UNAUTHORIZED with exit code 2 if destination is default reconciled directory and --authorize-gate3a is missing, preventing automated tools from mistaking a blocked run for success.

gate3a_execution_phases.action: Pre-execution volume and disk space verification (requires >= 2 GB free disk space on volume C:\)
Sweep any orphaned staging directories older than 3600 seconds
Initialize RunLockManager with exclusive OS-level file lock on run.lock
Materialize 18,845 accepted clips: stage with UUID -> 3-decoder check -> publish via os.link()
Materialize 130 discrepancy-screened quarantine clips: stage with UUID -> 3-decoder check -> publish via os.link()
Emit per-file disposition ledger CSV and comprehensive materialization report JSON
Perform physical destination inventory audit: exactly 18,975 files, 709,750,958 bytes, 0 missing, 0 corrupt
HALT AND STOP. Do not generate or lock final manifest. Await Gate 3B authorization.

locking_procedure.description: Load provisional manifest and cross-reference with materialization disposition ledger.
Assert all 18,975 files exist in cohort3_reconciled_assets/ with exact SHA-256 match.
Assert exactly 220 evaluation speakers across Australian, Canadian, England, South Asian, and US English (1,100 total evaluation speakers). Assert 20 gate speakers per stratum (100 total).
Set manifest_status to 'LOCKED', record Gate 1, Gate 2, Gate 3A, and Gate 3B approvals, and compute canonical SHA-256 of locked manifest.

unresolved_limitations_and_disclosures: Research Scope Boundary: Evaluates Mozilla Common Voice 27.0 (English) as distributed to researchers. No claim of verification against original uncompressed studio masters.
Decoder Evidence Distinction: 18,845 clips admitted via SoundFile decoding and physical MPEG frame inspection; 130 discrepancy-screened clips admitted via three-decoder consensus under Policy 2A.

Demographic Parity Limitation: Confirmatory evaluation is strictly balanced across five accent strata (Australian, Canadian, England, South Asian, US English; 220 speakers each). Gender and age distributions remain observational.
Downstream GPU Experiments: Gates 4, 5, and 6 remain strictly blocked. Zero GPU execution is permitted prior to Gate 3B manifest locking.
